description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the 3d cartoon diorama workflow: turn an owned image into a 3D cartoon diorama. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_3d_cartoon_diorama with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_3d_cartoon_diorama.
